entity_raw.definition_raw:
You can hold your liquor and poisons better than most.

Prerequisite(s): Great Fortitude.

Benefit(s): You gain a +2 bonus on Fortitude saving throws against ingested poisons.

You take no penalties when you are tipsy, and the penalties for being drunk or soused are halved for you.
